title: SR-1.37 Select discovered clients and complete connection
request: The owner requested selectable discovery, connection, lead selection and logged acceptance. Repository: memev-app; baseline 589d61ca1ce6853f0bb9a7a520fc45ff20450e54. Programme placement: contracts/programme/specs in memev, with repo memev-app in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Spec workdir remains null as required by the gate. The memev-app checkout goes through the verify CLI workdir argument only: memev contract new <this spec> --workdir <memev-app checkout> --base 589d61ca1ce6853f0bb9a7a520fc45ff20450e54, then memev verify <id> (or memev gate --workdir <memev-app checkout>). Verify runs every command criterion with that workdir as its working directory: red in a temporary worktree of the recorded base holding the head's test files, green in the workdir itself. No command criterion changes directory or names the app checkout, so red and green measure different code. Baseline ancestry (the app HEAD descends from 589d61ca1ce6853f0bb9a7a520fc45ff20450e54) is checked once by the separate precondition criterion T1-c02, not inside behavioral tests. MEMEV_VAULT_WORKDIR names the memev vault checkout; only T4-c03, which checks vault scope, needs it, and it must be set in the environment of the process that runs the criteria. Scope must check both repositories; the vault scope must include contracts/programme/manifest.json and must not silently skip contracts/. Depends on SR-1.36 verified and landed. Only the owner signs. No implementation before signature. Each task's red-green tests name every case they cover as an exact named subtest; red-green behavioral tests require measured failing-base and passing-head results; precondition and regression-only checks are labelled separately and are not red-green proof.
